pricing_basis.description: Freight per consignment is the sum of a weight component (₹6.00 per kg of billed weight) and a distance component (₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance).

service_level_rules.note: Only standard service is offered under this agreement.

premiums.name: cold chain premium
premiums.condition: Consignment booked as cold chain (travels in refrigerated vehicle).

accessorial_policy.note: The contract does not state any list of allowed/restricted accessorial charges; the only extra charge described is the cold chain premium (§3), and no whitelist or restriction language appears anywhere in the agreement.

exclusions.condition: Invoice line's c-note number cannot be matched to a Customer booking.
exclusions.description: Lines that cannot be matched to a Customer booking are not payable until reconciled.

rounding_rule.note: No rounding rule is stated in the contract.

ambiguities.description: Clause 1 prices the distance component on 'the booked lane distance,' but it is not stated whether this is the same value as a shipment record's actual/traveled distance_km, or a separately booked/planned lane distance that could differ from it.
Clause 4 states invoicing is 'typically fortnightly,' which is described as a typical practice rather than a firm contractual cadence, leaving the actual invoicing interval unspecified/variable.

notes: Only standard service level is offered under this agreement (§2); the contract defines no express or other service tiers.
Per §6, credit notes correcting earlier invoices must reference the original c-note number and the invoice being corrected, and must cover the full corrected amount.
